# Kepto

> Kepto is a privacy-first receipt, warranty, bill and document tracker for iPhone, iPad and Android. You scan a receipt, Kepto reads the details on the device and reminds you before the warranty ends. There is no account, no tracking and no server: everything is processed and stored on the user's own phone.

Kepto is made by Retriever Labs Pvt. Ltd. The website is https://kepto.com.au.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17.6 or later) and Android.
- Price: free to start. Kepto+ is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. The local price is shown in the App Store and Google Play.
- Free plan: up to 25 receipts, a photo on the first 5, one vault document, one tracked subscription, all themes, warranty reminders, sync, backup and restore, and tax and GST tracking.
- Kepto+: unlimited receipts, a photo on every receipt, unlimited vault documents, unlimited subscription tracking, PDF and CSV exports with date ranges, service reminders, advanced stats and custom categories.
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking, and no Retriever Labs servers. The Android app requests no internet permission.
- Scanning: runs entirely on the device. On iPhone it uses Apple's Vision text recognition and, on supported devices, Apple's on-device Foundation Models. On Android it uses Google's ML Kit and, on supported devices, Google AI Edge.
- Warranty length: Kepto does not look anything up online. It fills in a typical warranty for the item's category, which the user can change.
- Sync and backup: on iPhone, iCloud Sync through the user's own private iCloud. On Android, backup and restore through the user's own Google account. Any user can also export a full backup file.
- Document Vault: scans of passports, licences and IDs are encrypted on the phone with a key that never leaves it, and open only with Face ID, Touch ID, a fingerprint or the screen lock. Vault documents are never synced or backed up, so they cannot be recovered if the phone is lost.
- Also included: bills and subscriptions with renewal reminders, tax and GST on every receipt, 150+ currencies, six themes and four paper styles.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kepto.com.au/): what Kepto does, how it works and pricing
- [Support](https://kepto.com.au/support/): common questions about privacy, sync and backup, the vault, App Lock, promo codes, Kepto+ and tax, plus a contact form
- [Privacy Policy](https://kepto.com.au/privacy/): what data is collected (none) and where data is stored
- [Terms of Use](https://kepto.com.au/terms/): the terms for using the app
- [Delete your data](https://kepto.com.au/delete-data/): how to remove Kepto data from a phone and from the user's own iCloud or Google backup; there is no account to delete
- [Download](https://kepto.com.au/download/): sends a phone to the right store

## Get the app

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/au/app/kepto/id6775776531): iPhone and iPad
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=au.com.retrieverlabs.kepto): Android
